sourceName: Goods & Services Tax Network (GSTN), Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs
documentTitle: GST Return Filing Timelines & Penalty Structure Circular 2026

chunks.text: GSTR-3B is a monthly summary return due on the 20th of every month. Delayed filing incurs a statutory late fee of ₹50 per day (₹20 for Nil returns) up to ₹10,000 maximum plus 18% per annum interest on unpaid tax liability.
